{{Quote|If we can't have it, no one can.|Ossiki's leader, on destroying the food supplies of rival factions|<ref name="Characters" />}}
'''Ossiki's leader''' was the head of the [[Ossiki Confederacy]] and its [[Ossiki Confederacy Army|army]], which fought in the [[Toydarian seasonal wars]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. The leader believed that the rival confederacies in the war should be denied access to [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] if the Ossiki Confederacy could not have them,<ref name="Characters" /> leading the [[Army/Legends|army]] to become infamous for its use of chemical [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] to destroy food stockpiles. Ossiki's leader stopped running the organization at some point in [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|427|Ossiki Confederacy Army}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ossiki's leader was first mentioned in the character [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] entry in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Characters" /> The leader's quote about resources had been previously used in [[2001]]'s [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] without attribution to an individual.<ref name="Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
